newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buba to hold new conference after Dec 19 meeting.
newsitem.headline: Buba to hold new conference after Dec 19 meeting.

text.p: The Bundesbank said on Thursday it would hold a news conference after its next scheduled policy-making council meeting on Thursday, December 19, when it will discuss its M3 money supply target for 1997.
The news conference will be held at 1300 GMT on December 19, a Bundesbank spokesman said.
The Bundesbank usually gives a news conference at its last council meeting before Christmas.
